# Character Counter Pro

Character Counter Pro is a static, privacy-first text tools hub at https://www.character-counter.pro.

Important pages:
- https://www.character-counter.pro/
- https://www.character-counter.pro/tools/
- https://www.character-counter.pro/word-counter/
- https://www.character-counter.pro/case-converter/
- https://www.character-counter.pro/character-limits-cheat-sheet.html
- https://www.character-counter.pro/blog/

All canonical URLs use the www host. Tools run client-side in the browser.
